candidate_relations.reason: Kummell disease is a specific delayed complication of vertebral compression fracture characterized by progressive osteonecrosis and intravertebral vacuum cleft (pseudarthrosis), which is precisely what the clinical record demonstrates (vacuum cleft at L5, T2 double-line sign, delayed progressive collapse weeks after minor trauma). The candidate correctly identifies the fracture component but misses the osteonecrosis/Kummell disease diagnosis that is the requested final diagnostic object.
